Study these two charts, as you can see a clear trap setting up for 1000% swipe and 350% swipe respectively (Absolutely kidding)

The point?

There were NO/ZERO signs.

You fade front side of a rig name prior to any major clear out or seeing the exit come, you open yourself up to this outcome.

Is this easy to spot or know which ones?

ABSOLUTELY not.

But it's VERY EASY to know which ones have a rigged past just by looking at history (as you see me mention regularly).

Rig = avoid for me.

You're one swipe away.

They are fully controlled trading vehicles just baiting traders for their exit liquidity. It's the new way to sell stock.

Does that mean it's easy to know which will do this?

Of course not.

%.

In fact, you'd make money on most rigs if you faded them. But, it's just that ONE that cost you your account or quite possibly your career.

If you trade them, you're signing on the line and have to be at peace that it *could* be you.

This is why you see me constantly avoid them all and only special situations after a mega clear out/cover comes in would I ever touch and if I did, it'd be real small size.

I will NEVER use size or have heavy conviction on any small cap China name. I gave these up many years ago as you've seen me warn time and time again.

You're just running through a field of landmines. Sure, you may make it through most times but the more times you run across .... one of these times you'll step on one. It sucks, but it's just the way it is and it will ALWAYS be a risk if you trade them.

Pre market especially, no thanks.
